Table 1: Comparison between RoadMapper and related research on structured content generation. I: Information Display, G: Guidance. RoadMapper offers three key advantages: (1) Field and knowledge coverage are ensured by multiple fields, diverse types, and bilingual support; (2) Professional depth is ensured by dissertations written by Master’s and Ph.D. students; (3) Step-by-step guidance is provided through a structured roadmap format.
